sidecar.name: Covered wagon — blue and oxide

placement.position_note: An empty, unhitched reconstructed covered type at its unchanged earlier stand and bearing; the old stable identity determines its distinct finish and canvas aging. The original laid-by yoke is retained, not attached to a team. No owner, maker, driver or cargo is identified; riding and boarding are unavailable.

vehicle_type.note: Covered wagon v2 (T-3558): this wagon's own reconstructed canvas cover, sewn hems, five bows and laid-by ox yoke stand on the licensed photographic farm-box master (Old Cart by Lyskilde/longtail, CC BY 4.0, credited in assets/LICENSES.md), painted with its own seeded faded blue body and oxide running gear over the photographed boards; the canvas carries its own seeded ageing. The original record ID and exact coordinates keep its seeded finish family and canvas ageing. Canvas construction, colour, wear, bows and paint are reconstructed; no manufacturer, historical owner or load is identified. Occupied, driver, hitch, collision, riding and boarding interfaces are unsupported.
